methods.good_reduction: p does not divide the minimal curve discriminant
methods.ordinarity: Middle Euler coefficient a2=(#C(F_p^2)-p^2-1+(#C(F_p)-p-1)^2)/2; ordinary iff a2 mod p != 0
methods.surjectivity: Explicit Frobenius witnesses for Banwait et al. Tests 4.4/4.5 at ell=3; nonzero rational 3-torsion or nontrivial rational endomorphisms prove many negative cases. Five remaining negative cases are LMFDB classifications.
